query: SELECT seq, author_name, body->'files' AS files FROM channel_messages WHERE channel_id = $1 AND type = 'report' AND seq > GREATEST(COALESCE((SELECT MAX(r.end_seq) FROM agent_team_rounds r JOIN agent_teams t ON t.id = r.team_id WHERE r.team_id = $2 AND r.round < t.round), 0), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(s.seq) FROM channel_messages s WHERE s.channel_id = $1 AND s.type = 'round_started'), 0)) ORDER BY seq
